title: LNG news share -> TTF gas returns null control
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] GDELT lng GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads CF log returns by 3 days (+) but shows no excess over baseline; null control on European gas TTF=F log returns to test whether the LNG-news channel acts through gas at all [gdelt.gkg.lng_share -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0041)
message: Null control not supported: LNG news share vs TTF=F returns r=0.25 only at lag 0 (n=391, validity 0, supported_prob 0); rule long TTF after z>1 gives -0.15%/trade excess over baseline (51 trades, hit 47%), positive only in war test window (15 trades). LNG-news channel does not robustly act through gas direction.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.lng_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] GDELT lng GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads TTF=F absolute returns by 1 day (+): tests whether LNG news moves European gas volatility rather than direction, since the directional TTF null control showed no excess [gdelt.gkg.lng_share -> finance.TTF=F.abs_return] (parent: R2-0139)
